title: ¿because there are no stats for the players?

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: If you're talking about your scoreboard on your page, it's perfectly normal for it to disappear for a few minutes or even hours. It's just updating its stats.

replies.author: Dyspa
replies.body:
We do have stats. All you gotta do to see them is type avicus.net/Xiaomi_ in your browser.
If they don't load, that's generally normal. In the majority of the cases they tend to take a bit more to load as Petlas stated above.
